verdict: Native GPU phase3 does NOT beat native CPU v7 in the same window: Intel 132.4 vs 131.8 ms (ratio 1.00), taxi 146.7 vs 142.4 ms (0.97x). The GPU saves ~10-11 ms of CPU setup but pays ~13-14 ms upload + 2.2 ms download + ~16 ms combined transfer/bookkeeping and ~7 ms extra extract (answer copy), netting zero. A fair aligned-GPU baseline built on the same generic block executor is structurally implemented here but its plan export is not yet exact, so no aligned GPU number is claimed.
